title: Stream interrupt correlation and graceful snapshot replay
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Customers across Hosted and Dedicated tiers have reported corrupted/partial streamed responses after mid-stream disconnects. Root causes under investigation include edge proxy preemption during tenant throttling, missing in-flight snapshot checkpoints for KV cache, and inconsistent chunk attribution when reconnects are served from fallback model variants. This ticket tracks a cross-team mitigation: improved causal tracing for streamed segments, deterministic snapshot checkpoints at safe token boundaries, and a server-side replay mechanism to transparently backfill missing fragments to clients that reconnect within a session window.
acceptance_criteria: Full causal trace (request_id + segment_id + parent_checkpoint) emitted for every emitted chunk and stored for 24h
Server can replay missing chunks to reconnecting clients without duplicating previously delivered tokens when reconnect within 30s session window
End-to-end unit/regression tests for stream resume covering: early-edge drop, tenant-throttle preemption, and fallback model substitution
No measurable increase (>2%) in 95th percentile token latency under baseline traffic after rollout
Monitoring dashboard shows resolved incidents for top 3 customers that escalated within 48h
tasks: Instrument chunk-level causal headers and persist lightweight metadata in session-index store
Design safe snapshot boundary heuristics (token-boundary alignment using token checksums)
Add server-side replay handler that consults session-index and KV cache to assemble missing fragments
Add e2e tests exercising reconnect + replay with simulated edge truncation
Patch hosted-gateway to respect tenant-level graceful-quiesce flag before preempting streams
Coordinate with SDK team on resume handshake version bump and minimal client backoff guidance
notes: Observed pattern: disconnects originating at edge proxies correlate with tenant burst throttles. Edge logs show a FIN sent immediately after rate-limit enforcement.
Fallback model substitution currently loses original model_variant metadata; replay must rehydrate variant to preserve deterministic output when possible.
We will limit replay window to 30s initially to bound state retention costs; storage is in an in-memory LRU-backed session index with fallback to short-lived persistence for heavy sessions.
This work overlaps with A/B rollback protections in console rollouts; product will gate automatic rollbacks during early rollout of replay feature.
rollback_plan: Feature toggle behind 'stream_replay_v1' with kill-switch on gateway and runtime. If duplicates spike (>0.5% of resumed sessions) or 95p latency regresses >2%, toggle off and revert runtime PRs. Notify oncall and affected customers via standard escalation channel.
rollout_plan: Canary rollout to 5% of Hosted traffic for 24h with detailed telemetry. If stable, expand to 25% for 12h, then 100% for Hosted. Dedicated customers can opt in per-reservation; Private customers will receive a patch bundle and migration instructions.
